messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: runtime v2.14.7 -> canary 10%. sha=abc123
Maya: seeing p99 spike on canary, looks like tail at ~1.2s vs baseline ~340ms
Sam: on it. which metric panel?
Maya: Grafana link: https://grafana/redwood/d/rt_latency — p95 fine, p99 up, throughput steady
Alex: i can reproduce locally with loadgen hitting model 'x_small' seq=64
Alex: command I used: ./perf/loadgen --model x_small --seq 64 --rate 120 --microbatch=auto
Sam: pulled a profile — flamegraph shows big spend in kernel_selector.cpp: choose_kernel_for_batch()
Sam: also noticed kv cache hitrate on canary dropped from 0.97 -> 0.63 around deploy time
Ryan: FYI we shipped a heuristic change in this deploy: microbatch_auto_threshold 16 -> 32 (PR#4721)
Maya: that would bias auto -> larger microbatches, which can raise single-request tail for small-token requests
Eva: curious why kv hitrate dropped too — any related change?
Alex: logs show more frequent prefix evictions; kv_cache_ttl was lowered in the same release (PR#4719)
Maya: so larger microbatches + shorter kv ttl == more cache misses + longer kernel selection overhead. bad combo
Sam: recommend immediate rollback of canary to 0% and hotfix the two params separately
sre-oncall: rolling back canary now :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: runtime v2.14.6 -> canary 0% (triggered by sre-oncall)
Maya: watching metrics… p99 trending down
Sam: after rollback p99 back to ~360ms within 4 minutes :thumbsup:
Ryan: confirming both PRs affecting defaults: #4721 (batch heuristic) and #4719 (kv ttl)
Alex: dumping traces and uploading to S3 for postmortem: s3://redwood-perf/1774156789/
Sam: sample profiling output from the trace:
```
KernelSelector::choose         72.9%   kernel_selector.cpp:312
GPUKernel::launch              18.4%   gpu_executor.cpp:128
KVCache::lookup                 6.1%   kv_cache.cpp:87
```
Maya: action items: file postmortem, run isolated canary for the microbatch heuristic, revert kv ttl tweak until tested
Eva: add alerts: perf gate predeploy synthetic p99 < 500ms for seq=64 microbatch=auto; kv hitrate drop >10% during deploy
sre-oncall: will pin microbatch_auto_threshold in config and add deploy playbook step for checking cache metrics
Alex: also adding unit/integration test for kernel selector heuristic to avoid this regression
Ryan: drafting internal note, will escalate to customer comms only if we see user-facing errors
Maya: thanks all — closing after postmortem published. :white_check_mark:
